sys_variable_set.title: Day-2 identity request
sys_variable_set.description: Front-door variable set for the Lane C helpdesk catalog (JML, credential, access). Each variable maps to one EntraHelpdeskClient parameter or EntraHelpdeskGate pre-flight field (see map_to). contract_check.py keeps this a superset of what the client and gate require.

item_option_new.name: requester_id
item_option_new.help_text: Auto-populated from the submitting user; reference lookup, never free-typed. Half of the CM-5 separation-of-duties pair.

item_option_new.name: approver_id
item_option_new.help_text: Must differ from the requester — the gate hard-fails a self-approved request (CM-5).

item_option_new.name: privileged
item_option_new.help_text: Set when the request grants a privileged group/role. The gate refuses a privileged grant with no expiry (AC-6) — no standing elevation from a helpdesk click.

item_option_new.name: expiry
item_option_new.help_text: Mandatory in practice whenever `privileged` is set — enforced by the gate, not by the form, so the control holds even if the form is bypassed.

item_option_new.name: justification
item_option_new.help_text: Carried onto the approval and the evidence record; this is what an assessor reads.

item_option_new.name: role_template_id
item_option_new.help_text: Populated when the request grants an Entra directory role. Feeds the gate's server-side privilege classification (`_classifyPrivileged` — x_fed_day2_ops.privileged_role_template_ids) so a role the requester didn't tick `privileged` for can still be classified as privileged and required to carry an expiry (AC-6).

item_option_new.name: target_id
item_option_new.question_text: Target object (if not a role or group)
item_option_new.help_text: Fallback classification target for request shapes that are neither a group grant (`group_id`) nor a role grant (`role_template_id`). Feeds the same gate-side privilege classification as those two fields.

item_option_new.name: target_user
item_option_new.help_text: The directory object acted on — disableUser / resetPassword / resetMfaMethod / addGroupMember / assignLicense. Reference lookup to the reconciled CI, not a free-typed id.

item_option_new.name: user_principal_name
item_option_new.help_text: createUser payload.upn — the joiner's UPN, derived from the HRIT SSOT (Vol I Book 04) rather than typed where possible.

item_option_new.name: group_id
item_option_new.help_text: addGroupMember — the group receiving the member. Also read by the gate's server-side privilege classification (`_classifyPrivileged` — x_fed_day2_ops.privileged_group_ids), so a privileged group drives the expiry requirement even when the requester left `privileged` unticked.

item_option_new.name: license_sku
item_option_new.help_text: assignLicense — pick-list of approved SKUs; group-based licensing preferred where available.

item_option_new.name: mfa_method_id
item_option_new.help_text: resetMfaMethod — the authenticator method being reset. Identity-proofing is required before this item is approved (social-engineering target).

item_option_new.name: guest_email
item_option_new.help_text: inviteGuest — the external identity being sponsored. Sponsor + security approval and an expiry are required.

item_option_new.name: guest_redirect_url
item_option_new.help_text: inviteGuest — the post-redemption landing URL; constrained to approved agency hosts.

item_option_new.name: __temp_password__
item_option_new.help_text: resetPassword opts.tempPassword — GENERATED ON THE IN-BOUNDARY MID SERVER and delivered out-of-band. It is never typed into the form and never stored on the catalog record (IA-5). Declared here only so the contract check can prove it is accounted for and MID-resolved.
